metadata.description: A collection of resources for using GitHub Copilot for testing and automation.

plugins.name: requirements-test-coverage-mapper
plugins.description: Analyze your codebase for requirements test coverage, identify gaps, and generate actionable insights to enhance test quality and maintainability.

plugins.name: tech-debt-analysis
plugins.description: Analyze your codebase for technical debt, identify areas for improvement, and generate actionable insights to enhance code quality and maintainability.

plugins.name: code-review-advanced
plugins.description: Performs evidence-driven code review for pull requests, legacy modules, and quality-critical changes. Use when reviewing complex or multi-file changes, test automation suites, architectural refactors, or hot paths that need analysis of correctness, maintainability, security, performance, test quality, and operability risks. Provides structured feedback with severity-ranked findings, actionable recommendations, and clear rationale. For a fast sanity check of a small diff or single file, use the code-review skill instead.
